HediffDef.label: nanite electromagnetic receptor
HediffDef.description: An internal receiver used by the human-form nanite body to notice disruptive electromagnetic events and route them into the dedicated EMP-disruption state.

HediffDef.label: nanite coordination disruption
HediffDef.description: An EMP has desynchronized the body's nanite control network. Mobility and work efficiency fall while reconstruction is suspended, until the swarm can establish coherent timing again.

HediffDef.label: local collective connectivity
HediffDef.description: A readout of this synthetic pawn's current same-faction human-form network density. It is informational only; the actual reconstruction modifier belongs to the Collective Link system, and EMP disruption severs participation.
